mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies with a temperature of 58 degrees at Verona City Hall, and we are currently seeing a new moon phase.

For our city news, the Verona Police Department has opened applications for their Citizen Academy, a free nine-week program covering topics like O W I investigations and crime scene analysis. Additionally, election notices for the November 2026 general election are now available on the city website.

We have plenty of activities coming up, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol or live music at Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival takes over our streets this Saturday.

Regarding the police weekly report, on Sunday, August 30, 2026, the department received a report from the school district regarding an inappropriate relationship between a teacher and a student from 2019, which has since led to an arrest.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Raspberry Cheesecake. The restaurant is closed for the early morning hours but will open today at 10:00 AM.
